title: In development
summary: Built candidates and open testing, clearly separated from live features.
body:
Live testing: The Classic raid rewards give every dungeon three exclusive designs. The 14 added dungeons contribute 42 designs in two qualities; all 414 dungeon rewards are MAGIC. Fear, Hate and Sky receive lore-driven relics and equipped utility clicks. Gameplay and balance acceptance remain pending.

Live testing: Every Classic dungeon coverage adds the same Raid/Grind choices in 21 combat dungeon zones, including Fear, Hate and Sky. All 21 are installed for live testing; gameplay and balance acceptance remain pending.

Quest ingredient qualities - live testing

The fix for rejection of Aviak Charm (Polished) is deployed. Shared quest hand-ins and task delivery accept ordinary higher-quality variants for Normal requirements. Check completion, missing inputs and returned extras in game; explicit-quality and forging rules remain separate.

Waypoint crystals — live testing

Waypoints now have a glowing crystal with the existing a waypoint label. Fully close EverQuest, then use the normal launcher’s Play button to install game 2026102202 before testing. The crystal adds a model to the portal effect; appearance in Classic and Modern model modes and with particles low or off still needs in-game checks. Locations, discovery progress and return destinations are unchanged.

Classic robe waist correction — live testing

Game update 2026102204 repairs the native waist binding after the earlier 2026102203 repair failed on Barbarian and Half Elf. It covers the added robe bodies for Half Elf, Wood Elf, Barbarian, Dwarf, Troll, Ogre and Halfling models, both genders. Close the game and update through the normal launcher before testing. Native visual, dye and animation acceptance remains open. Item power, class eligibility and progression remain unchanged. Update details.

Dungeon Keeper visibility — live testing

The placement correction now covers all five confirmed waypoint overlaps: Befallen, Unrest, Najena, Permafrost and Nagafen’s Lair. High Keep and Cazic-Thule retain their already-separate positions. All seven still need visible-model and direct-selection checks. See the Keeper locations; use /target Instance_Keeper and hail if needed. No client update or dungeon reset is required.

THJ behavior and stock gear — live testing

The custom AA, spell focus and stock-derived gear update is installed for live testing. Scaling uses 131 researched Legendary items and matching standard EverQuest baselines. Classic level 50 and starter progression are preserved. Reopen the normal launcher for game 2026101902 before testing. See behavior details and open testing limits.

Custom AA behavior

  • Warlord’s Fury: +100% physical skill damage for up to 12 seconds, 60-second reuse.
  • Gut Punch: initial damage and +50% physical damage taken for up to 12 seconds. Press the Attack lowers AC; Grappling Strike lowers evasion. Their unverified opening/debuff values remain explicit tuning choices.
  • Act of Valor: spends 50% of maximum mana once and heals nearby group members for 2 HP per mana spent.
  • Harvest: activate to restore 40% maximum mana.
  • Mana Burn/Blast/Blaze/Volatile Mana Blaze: spend 10/20/30/40% maximum mana; retain 4 damage per mana as a tuning choice. All reach 15-minute reuse with full Hastened Manaburn. Target immunity rejects the cast without mana or cooldown loss.
  • Silent Casting: all casting classes, one-hour duration, 60-second reuse, suspendable timer. Subtlety and obsolete haste/duration modifiers refund purchased ranks.
  • Dimensional Shielding: separate Wizard AA protecting casting from hits, movement and hostile interrupt effects. Stuns and voluntary cancellation still interrupt. Its 120-second duration and 30-minute reuse are retained-value tuning choices.
  • Pyromancy/Cryomancy: 35% proc chance, initial damage plus DoT, opposite-element resistance reduction and compatibility with other buffs. Existing level/mana/trigger restrictions remain.

Evidence and testing limits

Released THJ notes take precedence over older test notes. “Most” static focuses, endpoint selection, the 10× interpretation and the supported area-target scope require validation. The stock baseline is ProjectEQ, not a recovered THJ or Daybreak database. Five weapon observations support the weapon extrapolation. No level-65 profile, new loot access, automatic AA points or free gear is included. In-game checks must cover mana failures, group healing, refund persistence, song focusing, actual hit damage and gear inspection before gameplay balance is accepted.

All-class AAs are now in live testing

The rank and access update is installed. See the released AA rules. Additional custom THJ effects are now installed as described above; encounter balance remains open.

Item and spell scaling is now in live testing

The combined release is installed. Read Equipment, Combat and Pets for its current rules. Historical THJ evidence does not establish every current THJ formula; spell-rank choice, mana sustain, pet contribution and maximum-AA melee burst still need in-game balance checks.

Shield and melee changes are now in live testing

The earned held-class melee and shield changes shipped with the combined release. See the combat guide. Gameplay acceptance remains open.

Separate level-65 and Planes of Power profile — not released

The expanded pet equipment and scaling changes are installed, but the level-65/Planes of Power profile and 389 additional merchant entries are still staged. Classic level 50 remains active. Nothing grants levels, spellbooks, AA points or epics automatically. Manifest Elements keeps its normal Mage level 59 requirement.

Guaranteed quality for substantial class armor — live testing

The installed update grants existing Ascended versions of 37 Crafted, Lambent, Darkforge, Ivy Etched and Totemic quest rewards. Substantial class-armor quests may qualify even when repeatable; cheap/basic hand-ins remain excluded. All original materials, money checks, faction and experience remain. The dependent Shadow Knight epic turn-in accepts Normal or Ascended Darkforge pieces, including mixed sets.

The 37 reviewed rewards are live. Already-owned items are not automatically converted. Other armor quests require individual review: Armor of Ro finishes through tradeskills, and Temple cleric branches need a separate audit. Materials, returned items, starter gear, spells, epic rewards and unaudited quests are not globally upgraded. Gameplay and progression balance still need in-game testing.

Remaining shared skill and spell cooldowns

The AA and cross-ability timer correction is deployed for live testing. Content-defined groups, including Harmshield/Cannibalize and Battle Cry/Throw Stone, remain open work. Bash/Slam, Backstab, Frenzy and non-Monk Kick still share a basic attack timer; Begging and Pick Pockets also share reuse. Linked potion/item groups remain. These links are under review; they are not included in the independence correction.

Adventure Journal & Epic 0.5

The eight journal quests and Wayfarer’s Oath charm have been built but are not installed on the server. The update uses three shared chapters followed by Guardian, Striker, Arcanist, Warden or Binder paths. These are not available rewards.

Combat and item candidates

Broader Monk and Beastlord fist-damage formulas and some existing tiered item corrections have a tested candidate but no recorded deployment. A frozen personal casting bar remains under investigation. The separate extra-class skill, trainer and offhand correction is deployed; the reported player issue was confirmed resolved.

Ongoing checks for deployed features

Broader equipment and class combinations, stats, regeneration, ability names and Bard movement/songs still need player checks. Those are acceptance checks for installed systems, not a claim that all of them are unreleased. See Features for the available systems.
